# AutoClip ### Turn any video, link, or live stream into ready-to-post clips. Open-source, local-first AI clipping for **podcasts, interviews, and gaming streams** — with smart reframing, captions, covers, and titles built in.

       



Website  ·  Download  ·  Live Replays (v1.6)  ·  Showcase  ·  Quick Start  ·  Docs  ·  Issues

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Português · Русский · Français · Bahasa Indonesia · Türkçe · Tiếng Việt · Deutsch


⭐ Free, MIT-licensed, zero subscriptions — everything cuts and renders on your machine. Star the repo if you find it useful!

--- ## Overview Drop in a link, local video, or **live stream replay** — AutoClip finds the best moments, tracks the speaker, burns in captions, generates covers, and exports ready-to-post clips for TikTok, Shorts, Reels, YouTube, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and Bilibili. **Local-first by design:** cutting and rendering run directly on your computer with no upload queues and no monthly fee. Bring your own API key or run 100% offline with **Ollama / LM Studio + Whisper / SenseVoice**. ![AutoClip v1.6 Live Stream Replays Walkthrough](docs/images/v1.6/autoclip-v1.6-demo.gif)

Home → 6 Live Replay sources → OBS WebSocket setup → Twitch import → Finished clip with captions & one-click publish.

--- ## What's New in v1.6 | Feature | Details | | :--- | :--- | | **6 Live Replay Sources** | Dedicated **Live Replay** tab supporting **OBS Studio, Twitch, YouTube, Kick, Discord, and local recordings**. | | **OBS Auto-Capture** | Connect OBS WebSocket (`4455`), trim losslessly (`-c copy`), and auto-queue clips right after you end stream. | | **Game Highlights** | Generalized highlight detection supporting **8s+** standalone plays with tighter vision/OCR budgets. | | **One-Click Repurpose** | Unified playable clip cards — switch target platforms in one click without losing previous exports. | | **13 Languages** | Full desktop UI, tray menus, and docs in 13 languages (`+ zh-TW, de, id, tr, vi`) plus Arabic RTL captions. |

Source copyrights remain with their original creators. --- ## Quick Start | Use case | Recommended setup | Requirements | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Desktop app (easiest)** | Download `.dmg` / `-setup.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/releases/latest) | Apple Silicon macOS or Windows 10/11 x64 (Python & FFmpeg bundled) | | **AI agents / CLI / MCP** | `uvx autoclip-mcp` or `npx skills add zhouxiaoka/autoclip` | Python 3.10+ (3.11 recommended) & FFmpeg | | **Self-hosted / Linux / Intel Mac** | `docker compose up -d --build` | Docker & Compose v2 | ### 1. Desktop App 1. Download the latest installer from **[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/releases/latest)** (`aarch64.dmg` for Apple Silicon macOS, `x64-setup.exe` for Windows). Portable Python and FFmpeg are bundled. 2. Open **Settings**, pick a cloud provider (or start Ollama / LM Studio), test the connection, and save — or click **Try the built-in example** with no API key. 3. Paste a video link, drop a file, or switch to **Live Replay** to connect OBS or import a stream recording. Pick your platforms and click **Generate**. > Installers are built publicly on GitHub Actions (`Desktop Build`) with `build-provenance.json` SHA-256 verification. Code signing and Apple notarization are tracked in [#119](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/issues/119). ### 2. CLI & MCP (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode & scripts) ```bash uvx autoclip-mcp npx skills add zhouxiaoka/autoclip autoclip --version autoclip produce talk.mp4 --srt talk.srt --platform tiktok --portrait-style podcast --json autoclip outputs PROJECT_ID --export-kits ```
Offline wheel, source install & MCPB packaging ```bash # Install from a downloaded CLI/MCP release ZIP wheel python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps autoclip_mcp-*-py3-none-any.whl # Or install from source python -m pip install --no-deps . ``` To build a local MCPB bundle without publishing, run `python scripts/pack_mcpb.py` (never run `smithery mcp publish` automatically).
### 3. Docker / Web ```bash git clone https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip.git cd autoclip cp env.example .env mkdir -p data logs uploads docker compose up -d --build ``` Open the web UI at `http://localhost:3000` (API docs at `http://localhost:8000/docs`). See [Docker Guide](docs/DOCKER.en.md) for bind-mount permissions and custom origins. --- ## Benchmarks Measured on an Apple Silicon Mac (LLM cost estimated with `qwen-plus`; excludes cloud ASR and AI image generation; check your provider bill for exact usage): | Input | Source | Time & Output | Est.
